name: Keeping The Faith
overview: Scripture reveals that keeping the faith is an active, enduring commitment grounded in the word of God, which produces faith by hearing (Romans 10:17). Faith is described as confidence in unseen realities and the foundation of our hope (Hebrews 11:1), requiring steadfastness without wavering because God is faithful to His promises (Hebrews 10:23). Believers are called to protect their faith like a shield against spiritual attacks (Ephesians 6:16), to build themselves up through prayer in the Holy Spirit (Jude 1:20), and to recognize that trials test and strengthen their faith, producing patience (James 1:3).
